name: Moonbind
source:
On a mysterious island, a malevolent fairy fears her own history repeating itself. She tries to break the cycle by causing great harm to those who only wanted to protect the island from a curse. Now, a young neko named Kaede seeks revenge for her kin who paid the price. Armed with her mother's dagger, Kaede explores the land to gain the experience needed to bring herself peace. With the voice of a disheartened hero by her side, they become unlikely allies as they learn more about one another.

[From [url=https://tereus27.itch.io/moonbind]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在一座神秘的岛屿上，一位恶毒的仙女担心自己的历史会重演。她试图通过对那些只想保护岛屿免受诅咒的人造成巨大伤害来打破这个循环。现在，一个名叫枫的年轻猫要为付出代价的亲人报仇。枫带着母亲的匕首探索这片土地，以获得恢复平静所需的经验。在她身边有一位沮丧的英雄的声音，随着他们对彼此的了解越来越多，他们成为了看似不可能的盟友。

[来自[url=https://tereus27.itch.io/moonbind]itch.io[/url]]
